Author: Quilun
Name: GlamImport
Punchline: Paste a glamour from Eorzea Collection and apply it with Glamourer.
Description: Copy a glamour from ffxiv.eorzeacollection.com, paste it in, and GlamImport finds the gear and dyes and applies the glamour to your character through Glamourer, or saves it as a Glamourer design. Requires Glamourer.
Changelog: Plugin icon, link to the GitHub page, and an updated description so a "glamour" search finds the plugin.
